ui.click_map_hint: Click the map to set your position or pick a district
ui.sos_hint: Pick the hazard type — the signal is sent with one click
ui.route_updated_road: A road was closed — your route was updated
ui.route_updated_shelter: Assembly point is full — alternative route suggested
ui.shelter_opened: A new assembly point was opened
ui.login_hint: Emergency operations dispatcher panel. Sign in with your account.
ui.simulate_hint: Drill scenario: creates test SOS signals from 4 distinct citizens in the selected zone and exercises the crisis algorithm. Close them with “Resolve” after the drill.
ui.click_road_hint: Click a road on the map to change its status
ui.offline_banner: The external map/routing API is unavailable (503 or slower than 5 s). Routes are computed from the local backup: last cached routes and the internal road graph. Service continues.
ui.offline_tiles: Map tiles are not loading either — showing the schematic road network.
ui.online_again: External routing API recovered — online mode
ui.chaos_hint: Resilience test: simulates an outage of the external routing API (503 / timeout). The system switches to backup mode automatically and citizen service continues. For drills only.
ui.profile_hint: No password — SOS is always one click. Your phone number lets dispatchers call you back and lets us text you the nearest assembly point (works even when mobile data is down).
ui.name: Full name
ui.profile_missing: No profile yet — add your phone so dispatchers can reach you and you receive SMS guidance
ui.no_phone: This SOS has no phone number
ui.priority_mode_hint: When on, your SOS gets Critical priority (#1) and only ramp-equipped, barrier-free routes (wheelchair / medical transport) are shown
ui.accessible_only: Only accessible assembly points are shown
ui.no_accessible_shelter: No accessible assembly point found — showing nearest ones
ui.sos_priority_sent: Critical-priority SOS sent — preparing a medical-transport-accessible route
err.invalid_sos_type: Invalid hazard type (fire, collapse, flood, medical)
err.no_phone: The citizen has no phone number
err.location_required: Coordinates (lat, lng) or a district are required
